mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE upstream AS ( SELECT id, proc_id, proc_name, source_table, source_table_short, target_table, target_table_short, target_is_temp, operation, sql_block_seq, main_table, 1 AS depth FROM table_lineage WHERE target_table = #{targetTableFull} UNION ALL SELECT t.id, t.proc_id, t.proc_name, t.source_table, t.source_table_short, t.target_table, t.target_table_short, t.target_is_temp, t.operation, t.sql_block_seq, t.main_table, u.depth + 1 FROM table_lineage t JOIN upstream u ON t.target_table = u.source_table WHERE u.depth < #{maxDepth} ) SELECT DISTINCT id, proc_id, proc_name, source_table, source_table_short, target_table, target_table_short, target_is_temp, operation, sql_block_seq, main_table, depth FROM upstream ORDER BY depth, sql_block_seq

WITH RECURSIVE downstream AS ( SELECT id, proc_id, proc_name, source_table, source_table_short, target_table, target_table_short, target_is_temp, operation, sql_block_seq, main_table, 1 AS depth FROM table_lineage WHERE source_table = #{sourceTableFull} UNION ALL SELECT t.id, t.proc_id, t.proc_name, t.source_table, t.source_table_short, t.target_table, t.target_table_short, t.target_is_temp, t.operation, t.sql_block_seq, t.main_table, d.depth + 1 FROM table_lineage t JOIN downstream d ON t.source_table = d.target_table WHERE d.depth < #{maxDepth} ) SELECT DISTINCT id, proc_id, proc_name, source_table, source_table_short, target_table, target_table_short, target_is_temp, operation, sql_block_seq, main_table, depth FROM downstream ORDER BY depth, sql_block_seq
